entitlements.description: Run the artefact for its intended purpose. The baseline grant; a product that grants nothing else still grants this.
Use in work performed for payment, including by an organisation. Distinct from `use` so a free tier can be limited to evaluation and personal use without changing anything about the artefact itself.
Receive the preferred form for making modifications. Relevant where the published artefact is compiled and the sources are not otherwise shipped.
A response to a report, rather than best effort. Says nothing about a time bound; that belongs to the offer, not the grant.
Continue to receive new versions. Bounded by `duration` on the offer when it is not perpetual.

seat_models.description: One named person, any number of their own machines.
A fixed number of activations, machine-bound.

Any number of machines for one holder. Distinct from `site`, which is bounded by an organisation: this is bounded by nothing. Enforcement still applies a practical ceiling to catch pathological use, but that number is not a term of the offer and is not stated here.

products.name: M365
products.summary: Microsoft 365 automation for RPA workflows: mail, folders, attachments, Graph-backed.

products.name: Workflow Lens
products.summary: Read a whole RPA process rather than one file at a time: invoked workflows grafted into one model, with contract checking and un-composition.
